notes.title: Update Information
notes.content:
Update 1.6.0.1 
Fixed the problem of not being able to boot up in non-Japanese OS.

Update ver 1.6.0.2
Fixed an issue where performance was not fully exhibited in other than "Full screen mode" depending on the environment.

Version 1.6.0.3
Rolled back the image processing that was changed in ver1.6.0.2.
Fixed a problem where a message would appear and the program would be terminated when the user was not using Japanese.
